notes: Docs node: the diff has no src/ or package change (gate.scope, gate.print). It holds the guides, their build, capture and receipt scripts, the specs and the two PDFs. I checked the scripts, the receipts and the printed text for security and privacy.

NET raw SQL: none added; no src/ change. The SQL, money, package and logging checks have nothing to find in the diff.

NET secrets: a grep of the added lines for Password=, AccountKey=, keys, tokens, Bearer and BEGIN blocks found only the sentence at index.html:1565, 'There are no secrets' (managed identity). The receipts hold no credentials. The sample people (Ada Lovelace, Grace Hopper) and addresses (EX1 1AA, EX2 2BB) are fictitious.
NET packages: gate.print reports no package change, so there is nothing to audit.

Privacy: the grep found no personal email, no local absolute path and no private name in docs/guides, and none in either PDF. The only drive path is the generic advice 'C:\src\uinsure-policies' (index.html:1226), which was already in the previously merged guide. ui/run-receipts.mjs scrubs the repo root and the home directory to <repo> and <home> before it stores output. gate.privacy ran clean over every changed text file and both PDFs.

Scripts: ui/run-receipts.mjs runs only hard-coded commands with spawnSync and spawn; no user input reaches a shell. capture.mjs deletes only png files and manifest.json in its own shots directory. The only network calls are to localhost. The generated HTML loads no external script, font or stylesheet; guide.css imports the local tokens.css.
